title: Grimsorrow Academy never lets you graduate. Without 2,000 tests, neither would I
author: GrimsorrowAcademy
selftext:
Hi! I'm a solo dev and I just put Grimsorrow Academy into Early Access on Steam.   
  
I made this game as a love letter to all rpgs, clickers, idlers and incremental games that i played over the years.   
  
I used AI to created a Custom Godot Fork and for coding, balancing, testing and some assets. Mostly Claude and some experimental local models. Even if it's general and most likely it was already said, I can't emphasise enough how important it is to use tests while coding with AI, and to use them for every part of the game. It will maintain your sanity.   
  
Free demo on the store page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4879900/Grimsorrow\_Academy/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4879900/Grimsorrow_Academy/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_content=aigamedev)  
  
  
I'll be in the comments, happy to answer anything about the game or the setup.
